name: Happy's Gifts and Apparel
old_description: Elevate your Mercer County business with professional custom embroidery from Happy's Gifts and Apparel in Hazen, ND. Perfect for logos on polos, hats, jackets, aprons, and team uniforms. Ideal for oil field crews, schools, churches, farms, and events in Beulah, Hazen, and Stanton.
about:
Happy's Gifts and Apparel operates from Hazen, North Dakota, in Mercer County. The business was started about five years ago by Keith and Morgan, a husband-and-wife team who moved from nearby Washburn to be closer to their growing customer base. Keith, a paramedic with over a decade of experience, and Morgan run the shop as a Christian, family-owned, home-based operation.

The company provides custom embroidery, laser engraving and cutting, branded apparel (t-shirts, polos, hats), insulated stainless-steel tumblers, and a range of promotional products such as keychains, coozies, awards, and magnets. They work with materials including wood, leather, acrylic, and fabric, using a laser engraver and an embroidery machine. The shop handles orders from small batches to wholesale volumes of 10–100+ pieces, offering free design proofs and bulk pricing.

Happy's serves local businesses and organizations across Mercer County, including oil field crews, schools, churches, farms, and event organizers in Hazen, Beulah, Stanton, and surrounding communities. They produce embroidered uniforms for work teams, laser-engraved awards for events, custom tumblers for client gifts, and branded apparel for employee recognition and tradeshows.

The founders emphasize a personal, hands-on approach—customers work directly with the people making the products—and a commitment to keeping dollars in the community. They position themselves as a one-stop local alternative to out-of-state online vendors, offering fast turnaround, local pickup, and wholesale rates with flexible minimums.
